name: math-modeling-paper-pipeline
description: Contest paper workflow from official problem intake to verified LaTeX/PDF delivery.

stages.exit_gate: problem-map and modeling-plan identify every subquestion, direct-answer target, data dependency, and rule/source dependency.
result-ledger rows resolve to scripts, source data, exact values, metrics, and units.
figure-ledger rows resolve to generated figures, source data, scripts, purpose, and caption claims.
LaTeX sections contain no TODO markers, direct answers are explicit, and claim-ledger references cover important claims.
verification report has zero FAIL, intentional WARN items are documented, PDF exists, and submission rules are current.

non_negotiable_gates: No invented contest facts, result values, references, or constraints.
No important result claim without claim-ledger evidence.
No absolute local paths in LaTeX or scripts.
No broad MCP filesystem or command access without explicit scoping.
No final submission while paperctl status reports blocked/todo/in_progress stages.
